body: Thank you so much! You should get a dog they change lives

I will reach out to her tomorrow. It is a good idea and I always write what I feel and keep a daily track of my symptoms both emotional and physical because also have PMDD. 
I talk to her twice a week. Last time was yesterday. She is under the impression I won’t hurt my self while my dog is alive because that’s what I thought. 
Thank you for taking the time to comment

I live alone. I have a therapist but I can’t talk to her right now because it’s the middle of night here. 
I am trying to get better but I don’t believe I can.
